lessons.meaning: Un análisis equilibrado reconoce la incertidumbre.
lessons.reading: The sources converge on one central finding. Their differences remain consequential. The broader implications are still debated. A balanced account acknowledges uncertainty.
lessons.writing: Escribe cuatro oraciones relacionadas con «Proyecto C2». Usa la regla de la presentación y revisa el orden, la claridad y la puntuación.
lessons.speaking: Explica con tus propias palabras un ejemplo de «Proyecto C2» y luego lee en voz alta: A balanced account acknowledges uncertainty.
lessons.sourceNote: Easy English: diálogo y actividades originales. Revisión editorial preliminar, sin validación externa.
dialogue: Examiner: What does this synthesis establish?
Candidate: It identifies agreement, uncertainty and unresolved questions.
lessons.readingExtended: Three studies appeared to converge on a common finding, although they used different methods and measured different outcomes. A careful synthesis preserved that agreement without hiding limitations or unresolved questions.
